Con la voz del móvil, para las críticas: With the phone's voice, for critical and high ones.
Con «Recordarme» el usuario y la contras: With “Remember me” the user and the password are kept encrypted on this phone, for this server only. Untick it and they are forgotten.

Desactivado por defecto. La sesión guard: Off by default. The saved session and the remembered sign-in can only be read while the phone is unlocked.

El idioma de la app. Si no eliges uno, u: The language of the app. If you do not choose one, it uses the phone's when it is one of these eight.

Elige el sonido de cada gravedad y, si q: Choose the sound of each severity and, if you like, of each kind of notice (the one of the kind wins over the one of the severity). It has to be a file of yours, .aiff, .wav or .caf, under 3 MB and under 30 seconds. Press the play button to hear it.
En casa la app usa la dirección privada: At home the app uses the private address of your server; away from home, the away address (a DNS name that follows your home, or the VPN). If one does not answer it tries the other and tells you what fails.
Entrar con la contraseña olvida la sesió: Signing in with the password forgets the session kept on this phone; the server and its alarms are not touched.
Esa dirección está fuera de tu red: sin: That address is outside your network: without an encrypted connection the app does not send your password. Write https:// before the name.
Esa es una IP pública: si tu operador la: That is a public IP: if your operator changes it, the app will stop connecting. Use a dynamic DNS name (for example casa.duckdns.org).
Escribe el código de seis cifras de tu a: Type the six-digit code of your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
Enter the user and the password.
Escribe o di una orden: armar o desarmar: Write or say a command: arm or disarm the system (I ask you to confirm), the status, the alarms, the nodes, the lights or silence the alarm.
Escribe o di órdenes: armar, desarmar, e: Write or say commands: arm, disarm, the status or silence the alarm
Escribe una orden (o usa el micrófono de: Write a command (or use the keyboard's microphone): the status, the alarms, arm or disarm. Arming and disarming ask for a separate confirmation that only you can give.
Ese archivo no sirve: tiene que ser .aif: That file will not do: it has to be .aiff, .wav or .caf, under 3 MB and under 30 seconds.
Este sistema no tiene instalado el asist: This system does not have the voice assistant installed.
Este teléfono no tiene código de acceso:: This phone has no passcode: without it nothing can be asked.
Este teléfono solo tiene código de acces: This phone has only a passcode: that will be asked.

Este usuario no tiene PIN: lo pone un ad: This user has no PIN: an administrator sets it
Estás usando el servidor desde fuera de: You are using the server from outside the home and this action is critical. Type your password again (or a code of the app) to continue.
Ha subido un contador de protección de u: A protection counter of a battery module went up
There is an alarm nobody has seen (%s).
Internet va lento o pierde paquetes: The internet is slow or losing packets
La app no guarda contraseñas de cámaras,: The app does not keep camera passwords, does not record audio and does not watch in the background: iOS does not let an app query the server while it is closed. Notices with the app closed arrive only if your server has push notices on.
La app pide Face ID, Touch ID o el códig: The app asks for Face ID, Touch ID or the iPhone's passcode before arming, disarming, silencing and unlocking, and, if you turn it on, to open it. Your administrator can require it, never remove it. A phone without a passcode is never shut out.
La app usa la de casa en tu wifi y la de: The app uses the home one on your Wi-Fi and the away one on mobile data; if one does not answer it tries the other. The away one may be left empty.
La central de alarma está bloqueada tras: The alarm panel is locked out after wrong PINs
La contraseña viaja una sola vez al serv: The password travels only once to the server. It is kept only if you tick Remember me, encrypted in the iPhone's Keychain. Away from home an https connection is required, and the app remembers the key of your installation's certificate to warn you if it changes.
The server address is not valid.
La pantalla Estado muestra si el sistema: The Status screen shows whether the system is armed and each node. Before arming, the server warns of what would be left blind or noisy. To disarm, the PIN is asked if your user has one.
La primera vez que se conecta por https,: The first time it connects over https, the app remembers the key of your installation's certificate. If it changes, it does not connect and tells you. You can also pair it by pasting the text of the QR code that Studio shows (armor-pin:…).
The door or window %s is open.
La red local está caída: el router no re: The local network is down: the router does not answer
La sesión ha caducado: inicia sesión de: The session has expired: sign in again
La tensión de red está fuera de rango: The grid voltage is out of range
La vibración y el modo No molestar de ca: Vibration and Do Not Disturb for each severity are set in the settings of the iPhone. Critical alarms only get past Do Not Disturb if the system gives the app permission for critical alerts.
Las alarmas activas esperan a que alguie: Active alarms wait for someone to confirm them. Alarm panels are armed, disarmed and silenced from here if the server allows it. With the app open you get notices on the phone when something happens.
Las celdas de una batería están desequil: The cells of a battery are unbalanced
Lo pide el servidor o lo has pedido tú,: The server asks for it, or you asked for it, but this phone has no passcode: for now nothing will be asked. Set a passcode in the iPhone's Settings.
Lo que la app no hace: What the app does not do
No hay internet y el router sigue respon: There is no internet and the router still answers: it is the operator's problem
No lo he entendido. Di «ayuda» para sabe: I did not understand. Say «help» to find out what I can do.
No puedo: entrar con la contraseña: I cannot: sign in with the password
No se ha cambiado: no se pudo comprobar: Nothing was changed: it could not be checked with the phone's lock.
No se ha confirmado con el bloqueo del t: It was not confirmed with the phone's lock: nothing was done.
No se ha hecho nada: hace falta confirma: Nothing was done: you must confirm your identity.
No se puede conectar con el servidor. Co: Cannot connect to the server. Check that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi and that the address is correct.
No se puede llegar a casa desde fuera. C: Home cannot be reached from outside. Check that the server has remote access on and that the away-from-home address is correct.
No se puede llegar a casa ni por la red: Home cannot be reached, neither through the home network nor from outside. Check the Wi-Fi or the data of the phone, and that the server is on.
No se puede llegar a casa. Si no estás e: Home cannot be reached. If you are not on your Wi-Fi, add the away-from-home address (a DNS name or the VPN) in the server settings.
Pedirlo para armar, desarmar, silenciar: Ask for it to arm, disarm, silence and unlock
